subject: Request: short-term trial uplift for peak QPS verification
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ingestai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Trial uplift for peak QPS verification

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We need to validate sustained peak QPS and tail latency for our POC (ingest pipeline). The test plan targets a 3-minute sustained burst at ~1,200 reqs/sec with 5–10s average generation (approx 1.1M tokens/day). Can Redwood provide a short-term trial uplift (48 hours) so we can run the full soak in our sandbox environment?

Key asks:
- 48-hour trial uplift to simulate production QPS
- Access to a gpt-like medium model variant (quantized) for latency parity
- Region: us-west (we will route traffic there)

I've attached the current test plan for context (poc-testplan-v2.pdf).

We'd like to schedule the run for next Monday morning (UTC). Let me know any required approvals or safety checks on your end.

— Priya
Priya Shah
Product Lead, IngestAI
priya.shah@ingestai.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ingestai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial uplift for peak QPS verification

Priya —

Appreciate the detail and the plan. We can support a short-term uplift but need to lock a few items before we greenlight the run:

1) Sustained vs peak: confirm whether the 1,200 reqs/sec is sustained for the entire 48h or a series of planned bursts (your note said 3-minute bursts).
2) Model variant: which quantized profile do you want us to route (q4_0, q8_0, or a CPU-safe fallback)?
3) Data sensitivity: will any of the payloads contain PII or regulated data? If so we need your DPA / approved controls on file.

Operationally we'll propose: 48-hour voucher tied to deal RBW-2309-INGEST, start window Mon 08:00 PT, automatic throttling at 1250 reqs/sec to protect other tenants, and an on-call infra watch (Jonas) during the test.

Marissa — can you confirm promotional voucher amount we can provision and any billing pre-auth needed? Stephanie — any compliance red flags here? Jonas — please confirm monitoring hooks/alerts.

I'll hold the requested 48-hour slot tentatively until EOD.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@ingestai.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial uplift for peak QPS verification

Markus / team —

We can approve a promotional uplift. Proposed terms:
- 48-hour voucher equivalent to 50k token credit at standard model pricing (covers the expected run and margin for retries)
- Voucher tied to RBW-2309-INGEST, revocable if the run violates safety thresholds
- Billing: require a card on file or signed PO prior to provisioning for audit trail; we can set an internal hold of $0 unless we see overage post-test

Linking the HubSpot deal here for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Stephanie — please confirm compliance check (especially if PII is present). If no PII, we can proceed without an executed DPA for a one-off sandbox uplift, but will note in the deal.

Priya — please confirm the exact burst profile (sustained vs spike) and whether you'll use redwood API keys in an isolated sandbox project (recommended).

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Growth Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ingestai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial uplift for peak QPS verification

Thanks Marissa / Markus —

Confirming details:
- Run pattern: 3-minute bursts to 1,200 reqs/sec every 15 minutes for the first 12 hours, then a 6-hour sustained soak at ~600 reqs/sec to validate tail latency under warm cache.
- Model: please route to quantized profile q4_0-medium (we tested locally for latency parity).
- Data: no PII in payloads, we are using synthetic payloads for the run.
- We'll use an isolated sandbox project and will provide the keys.

Start window: Mon 2027-10-25 08:00 PT — would appreciate the voucher provisioned by Sunday EOD.

Attached: poc-testplan-v2.pdf (for your reference).

— Priya
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ingestai.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial uplift for peak QPS verification

On Tue, Oct 20, 2027 at 11:00 AM Priya Shah <priya.shah@ingestai.com> wrote:
> Start window: Mon 2027-10-25 08:00 PT — would appreciate the voucher provisioned by Sunday EOD.

All — engineering is good to run the watch. Action items from infra:
- I'll spin up an isolated dedicated sandbox routing policy to q4_0-medium and enable KV prefix caching to reduce cold-start overhead.
- We'll add a circuit-breaker at 1,250 reqs/sec and set alerting at 900/1100/1250 thresholds to make sure we catch regressions early.
- Please share poc-load-config.json and ingest-poc-runbook.md — I'll ingest these into the runbook.

Marissa — once billing confirms the voucher, I'll schedule on-call and configure realtime dashboards.

Jonas
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
